neighbours.label: The CJK character 故 as a standalone token, in any sense: 'therefore' (故/故に/是故), 'old/former' (故人, 故伎), 'the late/deceased' (Korean 고(故)), 'reason' (缘故, 无缘无故), 'why' (何故). Not 'therefore' without it (所以, 因此, ゆえに, 是以); not words where the tokenizer merges 故 into one token (故事, 故障); English 'Thus' only weakly (~0.18).
neighbours.short: the character 故 itself, any meaning
